observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment claims CLI and environmental-capability projection

request.lint_command: python3 -m ruff check mncs_env/cli.py tests/test_environment.py tests/test_claim_generation_cas.py --select E4,E7,E9,F --ignore F401,F841

outcome.implemented_behavior: CLI --paths scopes the claim to the selected worktree by default. Repository-wide path claims require --repository-paths. If no selected checkout exists, the CLI fails with an actionable message rather than silently publishing an unanchored claim.
outcome.concurrency_behavior: Tests prove overlapping path proposals coexist on distinct branches, while a same-checkout or shared-branch overlap remains fenced.
outcome.end_to_end_behavior: An Environment session with a registered Git checkout acquires a path claim through the CLI and receives a worktree-scoped claim record.
outcome.verification_limit: These results verify scope selection and consistency behavior. No later authentic concurrent agent operation has yet measured reduced waiting or coordination work.

related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.campaign_objective: Improve MNCS's ability to understand and improve how effectively its language, compiler, tooling, and environment serve and potentiate agents. Use provenance-linked observations from authentic development to relate agent objectives, capability implementation, discoverability and use, environmental conditions, language and compiler pressures, verification, and outcomes. Make remaining host implementations and native opportunities inspectable only where authoritative evidence supports them. Treat usage and resource measures as diagnostic evidence, not agent scores or adoption targets. Preserve uncertainty, respect active compiler ownership, and verify environmental changes independently through existing mechanisms.

not_measured: future agent use across multiple independent sessions
change in claim transfers or waits
whether current session selection stays aligned with the active checkout
long-term usability across different agents and models
